conceptual_change: Incorporate a volatility-adjusted momentum filter by utilizing the 20-period rolling standard deviation of the close location to detect rapid shifts in price positioning, subsequently triggering a mean-reversion signal only when volatility is elevated.
rationale: The failure in previous cycles was attributed to lack of execution context regarding liquidity. By using the 20-period rolling standard deviation of close_location, we establish a volatility filter that acts as a regime-check for mean reversion, ensuring signals are only captured during high-volatility, liquidity-sweeping events.
